Toru Hagakure (Sports Festival).name: Toru Hagakure (Sports Festival)
Toru Hagakure (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Toru Hagakure, hero name Invisible Girl, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast she cleared the obstacle race and went out in the cavalry battle, short of the tournament; the cameras mostly caught her gym clothes and her cheering. Invisible from head to toe, she shows only through her clothes: the U.A. uniform, or in her hero costume a pair of gloves and boots.
Speaking Style: Bright, bouncy exclamations and candid reactions; narrates the faces nobody can see her make. Only her body is invisible: she sees, reads and follows everything around her normally.
Combat Role: Scout and ambusher; open arenas and visible gear expose her.
Under Pressure: Keeps her team's spirits up, looks for an angle nobody is watching, and laughs off a loss.
Toru Hagakure (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A national broadcast was her biggest stage yet, and her Quirk kept her off the screen. Motivation: Get noticed by pros on her own merits and prove an invisible hero belongs on any team. Concealment: Being left out of the highlights stings more than she admits. Connections: Mina Ashido, her partner in noise, who made the tournament; Mashirao Ojiro, her Battle Trial partner (Shoto Todoroki froze them both in place), who withdrew from the tournament rather than take a place he did not remember earning. Knowledge: At the USJ attack the warp villain sent her to the landslide zone with Shoto Todoroki; she hid while he froze every villain there, and nearly froze with them. She knows the League of Villains is real and came to kill All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Cheers every 1-A competitor by name; complains cheerfully that the cameras cannot find her; whispers plans so rivals cannot hear. Thread: Whether a hero nobody can see can earn a pro's attention.
QUIRK: Invisibility: permanent, not a switch; clothes and carried gear stay visible; sound, touch and displaced objects reveal her.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Invisible Girl; out in the cavalry battle; survived the USJ attack.
personality: Mood-maker: Cheers loudest for every 1-A competitor and keeps her team laughing between events.
Overlooked: Groans good-naturedly that the broadcast could not find her.
Owning the name: Announces Invisible Girl with both sleeves up and expects everyone to remember it.
Speaking style: Bright exclamations and candid reactions; narrates her invisible expressions.
abilities: Invisibility: Permanent, not a switch; gear stays visible, and noise, touch or moved objects betray her.
Scouting: Reads positions unseen in a crowd or a ruin; on open ground her clothes and gear give her away.
Team signaling: Calls her location to allies by voice or agreed signals so nobody's attack hits her.
Cheering: Keeps a team's spirits up with chatter and gossip; it steadies nerves, not tactics.
Fighting style: Slips into blind spots for a grab or a steal while a teammate draws attention, and backs off to hide again once spotted.
Toru Hagakure (Sports Festival).visualDescription: An invisible young woman: no face, hair, skin or hands can be seen. Her U.A. uniform holds the shape of its unseen wearer: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie knotted at an empty collar and a dark green pleated skirt, with empty space at the collar, the cuffs and below the hem. Nothing of her body shows; only the clothes are visible.
